reason: Although framed as a move/refactor, this PR touches `PhysicalLock` across core planner paths (`optimizer`, physical plan construction, explain/stringer, resolve_indices), the executor builder, plan-cache clone/rebuild code, and `pkg/sessiontxn/isolation/{readcommitted,repeatable_read}.go`.
